headline: Lead Azure DevOps Engineer | CI/CD | AI | K8s
page_title: Rajendra P N - Azure DevOps Lead
summary_html: Lead Azure DevOps Engineer with 10+ years of enterprise infrastructure, CI/CD automation, Kubernetes platform engineering, and production operations experience. Leads Azure delivery standards, Terraform infrastructure, Docker/AKS platforms, and reusable CI/CD workflows using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Helm, and Argo CD. Partners with Development, QA, Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams on engineering design, release readiness, DevSecOps controls, and complex incident resolution. Mentors engineers, builds Python/PowerShell/Bash automation, and combines Azure Monitor, Prometheus, and Grafana visibility with deployment governance and operational runbooks.

achievements.text: Builds reusable Terraform, pipelines, GitOps configuration, and self-service automation for repeatable Azure application delivery.
Reviews platform designs, mentors engineers, and aligns delivery patterns and operational standards with application teams and stakeholders.
Connects code-quality gates, artifact promotion, observability, release recovery, and incident runbooks across shared enterprise platforms.

experience.title: Lead Azure DevOps Engineer
impact: Reviewed platform designs and pull requests, mentored engineers, and partnered with Development, QA, Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams on standards, roadmap priorities, and technical tool evaluations.

Designed and maintained Azure platform foundations with reusable Terraform modules for networking, identity, storage, and AKS, aligning infrastructure changes with application dependencies and platform standards.
Built reusable Azure DevOps and Jenkins pipeline stages for builds, automated tests, image publication, environment promotion, and post-deployment verification.

Provided senior escalation support for complex production incidents, isolating Azure infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, and pipeline failures and coordinating verified recovery with engineering teams.
Developed PowerShell, Bash, and Python automation for provisioning checks, operational diagnostics, deployment readiness, and recurring administration tasks.
Operated AKS application delivery with Helm and Argo CD GitOps, maintaining versioned environment configuration, deployment health checks, and reviewed recovery procedures.
Integrated Jenkins and SonarQube quality gates with JFrog Artifactory publication, build metadata, and controlled artifact promotion for repeatable application releases.
Administered OpenShift application projects, routes, role bindings, and deployment settings; published onboarding patterns and troubleshooting guidance for platform consumers.
Maintained release recovery checklists, rollback inputs, incident runbooks, and post-incident corrective actions to improve readiness for production disruptions.
Deployed Milvus and Qdrant on Azure Kubernetes infrastructure with Helm, configuring persistent storage, resource sizing, access controls, backup procedures, and restore checks.
Managed Terraform remote state, environment isolation, plan reviews, and approval controls to keep infrastructure changes reproducible and traceable.
Reviewed Kubernetes requests, limits, autoscaling, and node-pool capacity with application owners to improve stability, utilization, and infrastructure cost visibility.
Administered Kubernetes access, workload identity, private service connectivity, certificates, and secrets, using managed identities and Key Vault for protected deployment inputs.
Integrated SonarQube quality feedback, container validation, and artifact promotion controls into release workflows; maintained versioned delivery packages and supporting evidence.
Configured Linux and Windows build agents, diagnosed dependency, cache, credential, and capacity failures, and standardized toolchain prerequisites for reliable execution.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Partnered with application teams to troubleshoot Azure delivery and implement reusable GitHub Actions workflows for builds, tests, and release promotion.
Maintained Terraform configuration and Ansible automation for Azure environment setup, reviewing deployment plans and Linux configuration drift.
Automated runner readiness and deployment diagnostics with Python and shell scripts, publishing troubleshooting utilities for application teams.
Standardized Docker images, Kubernetes deployment patterns, branch protections, and image-validation checks to make releases easier for developers to troubleshoot.
Built Jenkins stages with SonarQube analysis and JFrog Artifactory publication, validating release packages, build metadata, and artifact promotion across environments.
Maintained Kubernetes and OpenShift application deployments, configuring Helm values, routes, health probes, resource limits, and recovery steps for shared services.
Maintained Linux/Windows GitHub runners and shared build tooling, diagnosing dependency, cache, credential, and execution-capacity failures.
Protected deployment inputs with Key Vault and least-privilege service connections; validated required checks and documented release handoffs.
Organized artifact feeds and repository consumption patterns and coached engineers on merge workflows, pipeline ownership, and environment promotion.
Validated reusable workflow changes in isolated test jobs, checking input contracts, artifact paths, and environment settings before adoption by application teams.

Published binaries and container images to JFrog Artifactory from Jenkins pipelines and enforced SonarQube quality feedback before release promotion.
Deployed Milvus services on Azure Kubernetes infrastructure, validating Helm configuration, persistent volumes, resource capacity, monitoring, and operational readiness.
Developed Python and shell checks for infrastructure dependencies and release verification, improving consistent execution across Azure environments.
Delivered Azure infrastructure with reusable Terraform modules and ARM templates; reviewed infrastructure plans and environment configuration.
Improved service visibility with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights; partnered with developers on incidents and recovery documentation.
Coordinated AKS node maintenance and application upgrades, verifying workload readiness and recovery steps with service owners before production changes.
Implemented Argo CD GitOps and Helm packaging for AKS, providing versioned environment configuration and validated rollback paths.
Maintained Linux build runners and automated environment configuration with Ansible and scripts to keep build dependencies and execution environments consistent.
Diagnosed Kubernetes scheduling, image-pull, and service-connectivity failures, correlating workload events with cloud telemetry to restore reliable delivery.

impact: Administered CloudBees CI (Jenkins Enterprise), JFrog Artifactory, and Xray for SaaS product engineering, supporting reliable builds, secure artifact storage, and release execution.
Provisioned Azure application infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible, maintaining environment-specific release configuration.
Worked with developers during production incidents, defect isolation, and sprint retrospectives; turned recurring support issues into platform fixes and reusable guidance.
Standardized Docker/Helm deployment patterns for AKS services and payment workloads, validating configuration, health checks, and production readiness.
Developed Python FastAPI services integrating Jenkins, Jira, and JFrog to automate project onboarding and provide self-service access to delivery workflows.
Developed Groovy Jenkins shared libraries for image versioning and artifact publishing, allowing developers to reuse tested pipeline steps across services.
Built Python Prometheus exporters and highly available monitoring stacks with Ansible, Grafana, and Node Exporter to expose application and platform health.
Supported Qdrant deployment and administration for vector-search services, configuring persistent storage, resource limits, API access, health checks, and recovery procedures.
Managed artifact retention and dependency access for shared delivery services, troubleshooting repository failures and preserving approved build inputs for recovery.
Partnered with microservice developers on build dependencies, unit and integration test stages, test-result publication, and repeatable promotion of release artifacts.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer

Partnered with developers on Azure platform and CI/CD improvements, translating service requirements into infrastructure and deployment standards.
Maintained Kubernetes and OpenShift application configuration, troubleshooting routes, service connectivity, image pulls, and deployment readiness across shared environments.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
impact: Automated Azure infrastructure and application provisioning with Terraform, ARM templates, and Ansible, maintaining environment-specific configuration for controlled releases.
Built CI/CD workflows for API, database, and UI components with development teams, standardizing build dependencies and release promotion for shared application services.
Validated environment readiness and application dependencies before deployments, checking cloud access, network connectivity, and required configuration.
Validated cloud deployment permissions and protected credentials, documenting access and configuration prerequisites for application teams.
Defined Git branching and protected-branch checks, versioned artifacts, and environment parameters for repeatable application promotion.
Maintained Jenkins build agents and Python/Bash automation, diagnosing toolchain, cache, credential, and execution failures to support reliable shared delivery.
Integrated SonarQube code-quality checks and JFrog Artifactory publication into Jenkins workflows for API, database, and UI release artifacts.
Captured deployment manifests and configuration baselines for environment handoffs, helping support teams trace runtime failures to source or release changes.
Packaged containerized services with Helm and versioned environment values, validating deployment health and recovery before release.
Documented onboarding, platform configuration, and support procedures, helping developers adopt repeatable environment and release practices.
